caption:
CAM charges and reconciliations are a routine but often misunderstood part of commercial leasing. For owners, landlords, and tenants in Chester County and Montgomery County, clear CAM accounting protects budgets and relationships. CAM typically covers shared operating costs like landscaping, parking maintenance, snow removal, common utilities, and property management. At year-end, landlords reconcile estimated billings to actual expenses and then issue credits or additional invoices. Best practices: keep detailed vendor invoices, confirm lease language for gross-ups, caps, and expense stops, separate capital costs from operating expenses, and document occupancy percentages used for allocations. Seasonal services can drive variation; review vendor backup and question unexpected items promptly. For templates, checklists, and tailored review help in our region, visit dmsellscre.com/investors to get started or request a reconciliation review.
